scope.alert_trials: 100 identical independent synthetic converging-pair engines; not scenario diversity
scope.display: 720 native scan intervals for scenario1 from 5000 to 3600000ms inclusive; each timer includes due report ingestion from the prepared, hashed OASD rows, advance_to, frame render and canonical packet encoding. Asset read/validation and engine preparation are outside timing. Scenario2 uses 100 identical independent engines; setup and one no-alert warmup frame are outside each timer.
scope.flight: Engineering targets for direct in-process oa-flight core operations; no FAA or published external latency target is claimed. Message receipt and end-to-end flight propagation are outside this timer.
scope.host: native development laptop; not a network, facility or FAA comparison
scope.normal_push: one synthetic 60-minute scenario; warmup frame excluded; unchanged tracker/alert thresholds
